tasks.final_text: I went out to dinner with my grandparents tonight, and it was lovely. We went to Bevri, a Georgian restaurant, and we decided to get several dishes to share. My favorite was a cheesey bread with an egg yolk in the middle, called Khachapuri. I love to try new cuisines, so this was a true treat!

The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.
